title: Longest Resilient Subarray II
statement: The task is to find the longest subarray of nums (n up to 10^5) such that deleting any single element leaves a sum divisible by k. The key reduction is modular: all elements must share one residue r mod k and the length L must satisfy (L−1)·r ≡ 0 (mod k), so each maximal equal-residue run gives the longest L ≡ 1 modulo k/gcd(r,k) in linear time.
